questions_and_answers.question_text: Wànlǐ Chángchéng zhēn yǒu yíwàn lǐ cháng ma?

answers.answer_text: Is the Great Wall of Ten Thousand Li really ten thousand li long?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Chángchéng jīngguòle hǎojǐge shěng, yígòng yǒu yíwàn èrqiān lǐ cháng.

answers.answer_text: The Great Wall goes through many provinces and is altogether twelve thousand li long.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tīngshuō Wànlǐ Chángchéng xiūguo hǎojǐcì le.

answers.answer_text: I've heard that the Great Wall has been repaired a great many times.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì, cóng Qíncháo dào xiànzài yìzhí zài xiū.

answers.answer_text: Yes, from the Qín Dynasty up until now, there have been repairs all along.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bādálǐngde Chángchéng hǎoxiàng bú shi Qíncháo jiànzhùde.

answers.answer_text: It seems to me that the Great Wall at Bādálǐng wasn't built during the Qín Dynasty.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ǹg, nǐ shuōde duì, shi Míngcháo chóngxīn jiànzhùde.

answers.answer_text: Mm, you're right. It was rebuilt from scratch during the Míng Dynasty.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zài lìshǐshang yǒu zhème duō cì yòng Běijīng zuò shǒudū.

answers.answer_text: Throughout history Běijīng has been used as a capital so many times.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nà shi yīnwei dìxíng hǎo.

answers.answer_text: That's because the terrain is good.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèizhǒng dìxíng bǐjiào róngyi fángbèi běifāng láide qīnlüè.

answers.answer_text: This kind of terrain makes it easier to guard against invasion from the north.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒmen yóulǎn jìhuali yǒu méiyou Shísānlíng?

answers.answer_text: Does your sightseeing plan include the Thirteen Tombs?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ zhīdao nǐmen jiànzhù gōngzuòzhě duì Shísānlíngde dìxià gōngdiàn hěn yǒu xìngqu, wǒmen hòutian qù.

answers.answer_text: I know that all of you in architecture and structural engineering are very interested in the underground palaces at the Thirteen Tombs. We'll go the day after tomorrow.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Chúle gǔdài Zhōngguó jiànzhù yìshu yǐwài, nǐmen hái xiǎng qù kàn shénme?

answers.answer_text: What would you like to go see in addition to ancient Chinese architectural art?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tīngshuō yǒu jǐge jiàotáng, yòu kāi mén le. Wǒmen xiǎng qù kànkan.

answers.answer_text: I've heard that there are also some churches which have opened. We would like to go see them.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ yào dào Tiān'ānmén qù kànkan. Zuò jǐlù gōnggòng qìchē hǎo?

answers.answer_text: I want to go see the Gate of Heavenly Peace. What bus should I take?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xīngqītiān qìchē kě jǐ le. Nǐ zuì hǎo zǒuzhe qù.

answers.answer_text: It's Sunday and buses are really crowded. It would be best to walk.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ hěn xīnshǎng nǐmen jiěfàng yǐhòu gàide Shí Dà Jiànzhù.

answers.answer_text: I really admire the Ten Great Structures you've built since liberation.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nín tài kèqi le.

answers.answer_text: You're too polite.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒmen yǐjīng juédìng chīle fàn yǐhòu qù mǎi dōngxi.

answers.answer_text: We've already decided that after we eat we're going shopping.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hǎo. Cóng zhèr chuānguò guǎngchǎng jiù yǒu shāngdiàn le.

answers.answer_text: Okay, from here cross through the square and there are some stores.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Gùgōng yìtiān kàndewán kànbuwán?

answers.answer_text: Can you see all of the Imperial Palace in one day?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Yìtiān nǎr kàndewán!

answers.answer_text: How could you see it all in one day?!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shéi qùguo Zhōngguó, shéi jiù huì xiǎngzhe ta.

answers.answer_text: Whoever goes to China will always think of it.
